Ready-to-use material for research with language models: **workflows** (step-by-step procedures), **prompts**, **skills** that an AI agent loads when a task needs them, and **agent configs** (CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md templates). Each one was tested on a real case; drafts not yet tested are hidden unless you ask for them.

::: {#library}
:::

## Reading a contribution {#reading-a-contribution}

Every contribution starts with a header. The line that matters most is `QFLAG`, the verification level, also shown as L0, L1, ... in the list:

| Level | Meaning |
|---|---|
| L0 | Draft, not yet tested |
| L1 | Tested by the author on a real case |
| L2 | Reproduced by a second researcher |
| L3 | Checked across models or dates |

Models change every few months: the model and the date of the test tell you how much a result still applies.
